nodes.name: IMU Acceleration Sensing Subsystem
responsibilities: Measure raw 3-axis linear acceleration (X, Y, Z) from the physical environment
Expose acceleration register data over the I2C interface for retrieval by the processing subsystem
Operate exclusively in accelerometer mode; gyroscope and other IMU outputs are not used

nodes.name: I2C Communication Bus
responsibilities: Carry I2C read transactions from the processing subsystem to the IMU sensing subsystem
Transfer raw acceleration register bytes from the IMU sensing subsystem to the processing subsystem
Provide the physical and logical communication channel mandated by the I2C constraint

nodes.name: Central Processing Subsystem
responsibilities: Initiate periodic I2C read transactions to retrieve raw acceleration register data from the IMU sensing subsystem
Convert raw register values into scaled acceleration quantities (X, Y, Z axes)
Format the three acceleration values into a human-readable serial output string
Transmit the formatted string to the serial output subsystem for delivery to the laptop
Coordinate overall system timing and control flow

nodes.name: Serial Output Subsystem
responsibilities: Accept formatted acceleration data strings from the processing subsystem
Transmit the data over a serial (UART-to-USB) link to the connected laptop
Provide the physical serial connection point (USB connector on the ESP32 DevKit) used for both data output and device power

nodes.name: Laptop Serial Monitor (External System)
responsibilities: Receive the serial data stream from the embedded device
Display the live X/Y/Z acceleration values to the user via a serial terminal application
Optionally supply USB power to the embedded device through the serial connection

nodes.name: Power Supply Subsystem
responsibilities: Accept USB bus power from the laptop (or an alternative 5 V source) via the DevKit USB connector
Distribute regulated power to the processing subsystem and the IMU sensing subsystem
Provide any required voltage regulation for the IMU sensing subsystem

edges.description: Regulated power delivered from the power supply subsystem to the central processing subsystem (ESP32 DevKit, user-fixed constraint)
